messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-11-07T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Titles and span: Engineering lead offer packaging for Priya Raman

Team — quick context: Priya (ex-ScaleWorks, IC lead) wrapped final loop last week. Hiring manager (Talia) prefers a manager-first hire (people + platform scope) but candidate is signaling senior IC ambitions and wants technical ownership. Compensation ask: $260k base target, wants clarity on level and growth path.

Two paths on the table:
- Offer as L5 Manager (people manager, small IC org) — predictable manager track comp band.
- Offer as Senior Staff Engineer (L6 Staff IC) — higher individual contributor scope and different comp band.

Action requested: can we lock on level + comp band by EOD tomorrow so I can prep the external offer language for Greenleaf HR? I attached a comp-band-proposal.xlsx with calibrated ranges and suggested sign-on/eq. Notes: candidate prefers manager track if scope includes direct reports within 6 months.

Attachments: comp-band-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet with band recommendations and sign-on scenarios)

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Engineering, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-07T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Titles and span: Engineering lead offer packaging for Priya Raman

Agree we need clarity before we talk to Greenleaf. My read: Priya's profile and comp ask sit between the high-end L5 manager and the low-end L6 staff bands. Operationally, the team needs a manager but not a large org — more like a 1-2 direct report starter.

Recommendation:
- Primary: L5 Manager, base $250k-$270k, target equity 0.5%-0.75% (4yr with 1yr cliff), sign-on $25k for relocation/transition (if needed).
- Contingency (if candidate pushes IC): L6 Staff, base $270k-$290k, equity 0.8%-1.1%, sign-on $35k.

Rationale: preserves promotion path for manager -> senior manager; keeps compensation band parity for other L5 managers across the organization. If we pick the manager path, we should require a 6-month scope commitment from hiring manager (Talia) to own the people plan.

I pulled numbers from comp-band-proposal.xlsx and flagged comps vs recent offers in Bay area. If everyone is aligned I can write the manager offer template and mark it as requiring HC approval for the additional headcount slot (if we end up converting an IC HC to manager HC).

Laura
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 7, 2027 at 11:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Agree we need clarity before we talk to Greenleaf.

Appreciate the write-up. One operational point: if we hire manager (L5) we should confirm whether this consumes an existing HC bucket or requires a net-new HC (HC-4567). The product roadmap includes a manager headcount carve-out in Q1 but it's not currently approved to convert IC HC. If this is a conversion we need finance sign-off on comp delta.

From hiring POV I'd be comfortable with the manager path if the hiring manager commits to a 6-month growth plan and we add a clear technical IC anchor (e.g., a staff-level tech lead hire within 9 months). That gives Priya technical growth while keeping people responsibilities.

Suggested next step: Marcus, can you loop in Greenleaf HR with the manager path as primary, include the contingency L6 IC numbers, and mark the offer as contingent on HC decision by Nov 15? Also I added a short plan in the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Priya-Offer-Plan (see section: "Scope + Promotion Timeline").

—Karthik
Director, Engineering Recruiting
Redwood Inference
